protocol: 55341 development rows and 9225 confirmation rows held out first by group. Grouped 5-fold cross-validation with 3 seeds on the fixed configuration, every fold standardised with its own training rows; AdamW, warm-up 1 epoch, cosine decay to 0.1 of the rate, EMA 0.999, early stopping on validation cross-entropy (patience 10, at most 100 epochs), label smoothing 0.0. Final fit of 5 epochs (the median best epoch) on the development rows. One temperature per reading fitted on the out-of-fold logits.

adapted.held_out: a grouped split of 50% (5266 rows), seed 0
